_comment: User-level configuration for Claude Agent SDK
_description: This config applies to all projects unless overridden by project-level config
_theme_options: claude_code (default - official Claude Code CLI colors)
solarized_dark (popular dark theme with muted colors)
_color_enabled_note: Set to false to disable all colors (useful for CI/CD, logging to files)
_color_depth_options: null (auto-detect based on terminal capabilities - recommended)
_show_cost_note: Set to true to display token usage and API costs at end of each response
_truncate_threshold_note: Maximum lines for tool results before truncation. Set to -1 to disable truncation
_screen_reader_mode_note: Future feature - will add screen reader optimizations
